Loss-based bitrate (Rust engine)
Off: uses Device controls bitrate. On: this device adjusts from frame loss and network delay.

Nightjar watches frame loss and network delay and asks the host for a lower or higher bitrate, in place of Device controls bitrate. Needs the Rust engine and a host that offers bitrate changes; other streams use Device controls bitrate.
